decisions.reason: Building on established glass-silicon compound wafer capabilities, A likely meets aspirations and is retained.
Carrier wafers align with the firm's reusable carrier expansion and likely perform above aspiration, so drop risk is very low.
Copper interposer glass wafers fit the firm's multifunctional packaging direction and likely meet aspirations, so kept.
Off-the-shelf brand leverages existing standard wafers and lowers customer acquisition risk, so kept.
Distant from core wafer business and likely below aspirations after several years, E is dropped to reallocate resources.
